description: Get the most popular destinations (with cheapest cached prices) reachable from a city. Uses IATA city codes. Example: travelpayouts_popular_destinations({ origin: "MOW", currency: "usd", _apiKey: "token:marker" })

origin.description: Departure IATA city code (2-3 chars), e.g. "MOW"

name: travelpayouts_popular_destinations
